t: The Manrose 4" axial inline bathroom shower extractor fan kit with an integrated LED light and timer is designed for effective moisture and odour removal in domestic properties. Ideal for bathrooms and shower rooms requiring ventilation, this unit can be mounted in a loft or ceiling void, offering quiet operation of 41dBA at 3m. It features an adjustable overrun timer up to 20 minutes and a warm white LED light for clear illumination. The kit includes 1.5m flexible ducting, turning vane, and a backdraft shutter for comprehensive installation, ensuring reliable performance.
b: Mount in Loft or Ceiling Void
